verses.text: صَلَاةُ الَّذِى فِى كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَفِى صَفَرْ
verses.transcription: salaatul lazii fii kulli shahrin wa fii safar

verses.text: حَمَانِى عَلَى مَاحٍ مَّحَا الْحَبْسَ وَالسَّفَرْ
verses.transcription: hamaanii halaa maahin mahal habsa was safar

verses.text: فَلَاحِ بِكَوْنِى عَبْدَ رَبِّى خَدِيمَهُ
verses.transcription: falaahi bikawnii habda rabbii khadiimahu

verses.text: عَجِيبٌ بِهِ لِى جَادَ مُغْنٍ عَنِ النَّفَرْ
verses.transcription: hajiibun bihi lii jaada mughnin hanin nafar

verses.text: رَضِيتُ عَنِ الْمَوْلَى وَعَنْ خَيْرِ خَلْقِهِ
verses.transcription: radiitu hanil mawlaa wa han khayri khalqihi

verses.text: عَلَيْهِ سَلَامَا مَنْ لَّهُ أُبْتُ بِالظَّفَرْ
verses.transcription: halayhi salaamaa man lahu ubtu biz zafar

verses.text: صَلَاةٌ وَتَسْلِيمٌ مَّعَ الْبِشْرِ سَرْمَدًا
verses.transcription: salaatun wa tasliimun mahal bishri sarmadan

verses.text: عَلَى مَنْ بِهِ مُكْثِى مَعَ الْأَمْنِ وَالْبَشَرْ
verses.transcription: halaa man bihi muksii mahal amni wal bashar

verses.text: فِرَارِىَ بِالْمُخْتَارِ مِنْ قَبْلُ قَادَ لِى
verses.transcription: firaariya bil mukhtaari min qablu qaada lii

verses.text: مُكُوثًا وَتَبْشِيرًا لَّدَى الْجِنِّ وَالْبَشَرْ
verses.transcription: mukuusan wa tabshiran ladal jinni wal bashar

verses.text: رَفَعْتُ شُكُورًا بَعْدَ حَمْدٍ مُّخَلَّدٍ
verses.transcription: rafahtu shukuuran bahda hamdin mukhalladin

verses.text: لِّبَاقٍ مَحَا ضُرِّى الَّذِى حَازَهُ الْقَدَرْ
verses.transcription: libaaqin mahaa durril lazii haazahul qadar

verses.text: صَلَاةُ الَّذِى أَدْعُوهُ عَبْدًا لَّهُ بِهِ
verses.transcription: salaatul lazii adhuuhu habdan lahu bihi

verses.text: عَلَى مَنْ بِهِ لِى قَادَ صَفْوًا بِلَا كَدَرْ
verses.transcription: halaa man bihi lii qaada safwan bilaa kadar

verses.text: فَصَاحَةُ خَيْرِ الْخَلْقِ أَبْدَتْ قَصَآءِدِى
verses.transcription: fasaahatu khayril khalqi abdat qasaa-idii

verses.text: وَكَوْنِى بِهَا عَبْدًا خَدِيمًا لَّهُ ظَهَرْ
verses.transcription: wa kawnii bihaa habdan khadiiman lahu zahar

verses.text: رَبِحْتُ رَبَاحًا لَّمْ يَكُنْ قَطُّ مِثْلُهُ
verses.transcription: rabihtu rabaahan lam yakun qattu misluhu

verses.text: بِفَضْلِ الَّذِى كَوْنِى حَبِيبًا لَّهُ اشْتَهَرْ
verses.transcription: bifadlil lazii kawnii habiiban lahush tahar

verses.text: صَلَاةُ الَّذِى لِى قَادَ كَوْنِى خَلِيلَهُ
verses.transcription: salaatul lazii lii qaada kawnii khaliilahu

verses.text: عَلَى مَنْ بِهِ لِى طَيَّبَ الْبَدْوَ وَالْحَضَرْ
verses.transcription: halaa man bihi lii tayyabal badwa wal hadar

verses.text: فُتُوحَاتُ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ أَنْقَتْ مَعَائِبِى
verses.transcription: futuuhaatu rabbil harshi anqat mahaa-ibii

verses.text: بِجَاهِ الَّذِى بَاهَتْ بِهِ مَنْ عَلَوْ مُضَرْ
verses.transcription: bijaahil lazii baahat bihi man halaw mudar

verses.text: رَبَاحِىَ فِى إِخْدَامِ خَيْرِ الْوَرَى بَدَا
verses.transcription: rabaahiya fii ikhdaami khayril waraa badaa

verses.text: وَفِى كُلِّ شَهْرٍ زَيْدُ رِبْحِى وَفِى صَفَرْ
verses.transcription: wa fii kulli shahrin zaydu ribhii wa fii safar

bayts.text: صَلَاةُ الَّذِى فِى كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَفِى صَفَرْ ۞ حَمَانِى عَلَى مَاحٍ مَّحَا الْحَبْسَ وَالسَّفَرْ

translations.it.karamati: La benedizione di Colui che in ogni mese, e in Ṣafar, mi ha protetto, (sia) sul Cancellatore che ha cancellato la prigionia e il viaggio (forzato).
translations.en.karamati: The blessing of Him Who in every month, and in Ṣafar, protected me, (be) upon the Effacer who effaced captivity and the (forced) journey.
translations.fr.karamati: La bénédiction de Celui qui en chaque mois, et en Ṣafar, m'a protégé, (soit) sur l'Effaceur qui a effacé la captivité et le voyage (forcé).

bayts.text: فَلَاحِ بِكَوْنِى عَبْدَ رَبِّى خَدِيمَهُ ۞ عَجِيبٌ بِهِ لِى جَادَ مُغْنٍ عَنِ النَّفَرْ

translations.it.karamati: Il successo (è) nel mio essere servo del mio Signore, suo servitore: una meraviglia per mezzo di lui mi ha elargito Colui che rende indipendenti dalla schiera (degli uomini).
translations.en.karamati: Success (lies) in my being the slave of my Lord, his servant: a marvel through him the One Who frees from the throng (of men) has bestowed on me.
translations.fr.karamati: Le succès (est) dans mon être serviteur de mon Seigneur, son servant : une merveille par lui m'a octroyé Celui qui rend indépendant de la troupe (des hommes).

bayts.text: رَضِيتُ عَنِ الْمَوْلَى وَعَنْ خَيْرِ خَلْقِهِ ۞ عَلَيْهِ سَلَامَا مَنْ لَّهُ أُبْتُ بِالظَّفَرْ

translations.it.karamati: Sono compiaciuto del Signore e del migliore delle Sue creature — su di lui un saluto di pace — colui per mezzo del quale sono tornato con il trionfo.
translations.en.karamati: I am well pleased with the Master and with the best of His creatures — upon him peace — through whom I returned with triumph.
translations.fr.karamati: Je suis satisfait du Maître et du meilleur de Ses créatures — sur lui un salut de paix — celui par qui je suis revenu avec le triomphe.

bayts.text: صَلَاةٌ وَتَسْلِيمٌ مَّعَ الْبِشْرِ سَرْمَدًا ۞ عَلَى مَنْ بِهِ مُكْثِى مَعَ الْأَمْنِ وَالْبَشَرْ

translations.it.karamati: Benedizione e saluto di pace, con la letizia, per sempre, su colui per mezzo del quale (è) il mio dimorare con la sicurezza e la gioia.
translations.en.karamati: Blessing and peace, with gladness, forever, upon him through whom (is) my abiding with safety and joy.
translations.fr.karamati: Bénédiction et salut de paix, avec la joie, à jamais, sur celui par qui (est) mon séjour avec la sécurité et la joie.

bayts.text: فِرَارِىَ بِالْمُخْتَارِ مِنْ قَبْلُ قَادَ لِى ۞ مُكُوثًا وَتَبْشِيرًا لَّدَى الْجِنِّ وَالْبَشَرْ

translations.it.karamati: La mia fuga (verso Dio), per mezzo del Prescelto, già prima mi ha condotto il dimorare e la buona novella presso i jinn e gli uomini.
translations.en.karamati: My flight (to God), through the Chosen, already before led to me abiding and glad tidings among jinn and men.
translations.fr.karamati: Ma fuite (vers Dieu), par l'Élu, déjà auparavant m'a amené le séjour et la bonne nouvelle auprès des djinns et des hommes.

bayts.text: رَفَعْتُ شُكُورًا بَعْدَ حَمْدٍ مُّخَلَّدٍ ۞ لِّبَاقٍ مَحَا ضُرِّى الَّذِى حَازَهُ الْقَدَرْ

translations.it.karamati: Ho innalzato una gratitudine, dopo una lode resa eterna, a un Permanente che ha cancellato il mio danno, quello che il decreto aveva racchiuso.
translations.en.karamati: I have raised gratitude, after an eternalised praise, to an Everlasting One Who effaced my harm, that which the decree had held.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai élevé une gratitude, après une louange rendue éternelle, à un Permanent qui a effacé mon dommage, celui que le décret avait renfermé.

bayts.text: صَلَاةُ الَّذِى أَدْعُوهُ عَبْدًا لَّهُ بِهِ ۞ عَلَى مَنْ بِهِ لِى قَادَ صَفْوًا بِلَا كَدَرْ

translations.it.karamati: La benedizione di Colui che invoco, servo Suo per mezzo di lui, (sia) su colui per mezzo del quale mi ha condotto limpidezza senza torbidezza.
translations.en.karamati: The blessing of Him Whom I invoke, His slave through him, (be) upon him through whom He led to me clarity without turbidity.
translations.fr.karamati: La bénédiction de Celui que j'invoque, Son serviteur par lui, (soit) sur celui par qui Il m'a amené limpidité sans trouble.

bayts.text: فَصَاحَةُ خَيْرِ الْخَلْقِ أَبْدَتْ قَصَآءِدِى ۞ وَكَوْنِى بِهَا عَبْدًا خَدِيمًا لَّهُ ظَهَرْ

translations.it.karamati: L'eloquenza del migliore del creato ha fatto apparire le mie qaṣīde, e il mio essere per mezzo di esse suo servo e servitore è divenuto manifesto.
translations.en.karamati: The eloquence of the best of creation brought forth my qaṣīdas, and my being through them his slave and servant has become manifest.
translations.fr.karamati: L'éloquence du meilleur de la création a fait apparaître mes qaṣīdas, et mon être par elles son serviteur et servant est devenu manifeste.

bayts.text: رَبِحْتُ رَبَاحًا لَّمْ يَكُنْ قَطُّ مِثْلُهُ ۞ بِفَضْلِ الَّذِى كَوْنِى حَبِيبًا لَّهُ اشْتَهَرْ

translations.it.karamati: Ho guadagnato un guadagno il cui pari non fu mai, per la grazia di Colui presso il Quale il mio essere Suo amato è divenuto noto.
translations.en.karamati: I have gained a gain whose like never was, by the grace of Him with Whom my being His beloved has become renowned.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai gagné un gain dont le pareil ne fut jamais, par la grâce de Celui auprès de Qui mon être Son bien-aimé est devenu notoire.

bayts.text: صَلَاةُ الَّذِى لِى قَادَ كَوْنِى خَلِيلَهُ ۞ عَلَى مَنْ بِهِ لِى طَيَّبَ الْبَدْوَ وَالْحَضَرْ

translations.it.karamati: La benedizione di Colui che mi ha condotto il mio essere Suo intimo (sia) su colui per mezzo del quale mi ha reso buoni il deserto e la città.
translations.en.karamati: The blessing of Him Who led to me my being His intimate (be) upon him through whom He made the desert and the town good for me.
translations.fr.karamati: La bénédiction de Celui qui m'a amené mon être Son intime (soit) sur celui par qui Il m'a rendu bons le désert et la cité.

bayts.text: فُتُوحَاتُ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ أَنْقَتْ مَعَائِبِى ۞ بِجَاهِ الَّذِى بَاهَتْ بِهِ مَنْ عَلَوْ مُضَرْ

translations.it.karamati: Le aperture del Signore del Trono hanno purificato i miei difetti, per il prestigio di colui per mezzo del quale si sono gloriati coloro che sono saliti di Muḍar.
translations.en.karamati: The openings of the Lord of the Throne have purified my faults, by the standing of him through whom those of Muḍar who rose took pride.
translations.fr.karamati: Les ouvertures du Seigneur du Trône ont purifié mes défauts, par le prestige de celui par qui se sont glorifiés ceux qui se sont élevés de Muḍar.

bayts.text: رَبَاحِىَ فِى إِخْدَامِ خَيْرِ الْوَرَى بَدَا ۞ وَفِى كُلِّ شَهْرٍ زَيْدُ رِبْحِى وَفِى صَفَرْ

translations.it.karamati: Il mio guadagno nel servizio del migliore del creato è apparso, e in ogni mese (vi è) l'accrescimento del mio guadagno, e in Ṣafar.
translations.en.karamati: My gain in the service of the best of creation has appeared, and in every month (there is) the increase of my gain, and in Ṣafar.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon gain dans le service du meilleur de la création est apparu, et en chaque mois (il y a) l'accroissement de mon gain, et en Ṣafar.
